correctness.rationale: The weighted monomial norm is exactly (1+tau*q^(n-N))/(n+1). A bilateral Laurent limit holds uniformly on compact subannuli by explicit geometric majorants; Ramanujan 1psi1 gives one simple annular zero. Winding plus s^N counts exactly N/N+1 kernel zeros. The distinct interior rescaling excludes zeros away from the jump. 69 independent finite consistency assertions passed but are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural one-jump radial Bergman family displays a sharp separation: N zeros concentrate at the jump circle and precisely one isolated theta-product outlier remains, with an exact N-to-N+1 radius transition. This quantitative geometric spectral-kernel phenomenon is more informative than generic existence of zeros and motivates radial kernel asymptotics and zero geometry.
